maugham-trembling-leaf: The Trembling of a Leaf: Little Stories of the South Sea Islands

maugham-trembling-leaf.case: Bloom lists Maugham's Collected Short Stories (1951, not PD as a collection). Its main pre-1931 parts are The Trembling of a Leaf (1921, with 'Rain') and The Casuarina Tree (1926), both US-PD.
maugham-trembling-leaf.note: Ashenden (1928) is also PD but I did not look for it; most later stories are post-1931.
